name: 神与信仰
intro: 力量的最高来源。本库默认：圣光由信念点燃，众多信念汇聚成神，神再回应信者——所以神需要信徒，被遗忘的神会衰亡。采用剧可以改用其他两种形而上学：神主动赐予（有神论），或根本无神、只有信念（无神圣光）。下列条目是可组合的「神学模式」，不是具体神祇；具体神名、教义由采用剧原创。

entries.name: 光
entries.summary: 默认模式：一个由无数信者的信念汇成的至高之光，被圣光教会侍奉。它不说话，通过圣迹、光痕者与天使回应。
entries.cost: 信念分裂即光分裂：教派之争会削弱圣光。
entries.visual: 无形象；以七芒太阳盘为标志。

references.work: 中世纪一神信仰（只借结构）

image.brief: Interior of an immense original cathedral-like hall of pale stone with no statues or icons, where a vast column of sourceless white-gold light fills the space beneath a high open oculus, countless tiny worshippers kneeling in rows on the floor far below, dust motes glowing in the light; inlaid in the floor at the center is a sun disc with exactly seven short triangular rays, evenly spaced around a solid disc (count them: seven, not eight).

entries.name: 众神殿
entries.summary: 多神模式：一组各掌一域的神（战争、海、死亡、丰饶、智慧、锻造……），彼此有亲缘、争斗与婚姻；每位神有自己的祭司、圣地与圣武士。
entries.cost: 神与神的争斗波及凡人；侍奉一位神会得罪另一位。
entries.visual: 每位神一个标志物与颜色。

references.note: 奥林匹斯十二神、阿萨神族与华纳神族

image.brief: A colossal open-air hall at dusk lined with towering ancient statues of original fantasy gods, each different and each holding its own symbol (a spear, a fishing spear, a sheaf of wheat, an owl, a smith's hammer, a lantern), braziers burning at their feet, tiny pilgrims walking between them for scale; none resembles any real mythology's iconic statues.

entries.name: 古神与土地之灵
entries.summary: 比教会更古老的神：一座山、一条河、一片林各有其灵，乡民在圣井与立石前供奉。它们力量局限于本地，但在本地极强。

xianxia.concept: 山神 / 土地 / 河伯（参照）

entries.cost: 被开发、被遗忘或被教会驱逐时会报复。
entries.visual: 以圣井、立石、古树为居所，显现时像天气或动物。

references.work: 罗马 genius loci 与北欧 landvættir

image.brief: A mossy holy well in a hollow among ancient oaks at dawn, beside it a weathered standing stone hung with strips of cloth, ribbons and small offerings of bread and coins, a faint translucent shape of a great antlered spirit visible in the mist above the water, no people.

entries.name: 被遗忘的神
entries.summary: 失去信徒的神：力量衰减，有的沉睡在废墟里，有的为了重新被记住而与凡人立约。是契约师最危险也最慷慨的赞助者。
entries.cost: 它们需要的是崇拜，代价是把契约者变成新的祭司。
entries.visual: 残破的神像、只剩一角的神殿。

image.brief: A ruined, overgrown temple deep in a forest, its roof collapsed, a huge broken statue of a forgotten god lying face-down among roots and ivy, a single shaft of light falling on a small fresh offering of a candle at its stone hand, mist and silence, no people.

entries.name: 赞助者
entries.summary: 能与凡人立约、但不是神的强大存在：妖精君主、恶魔亲王、巫妖王、外域之物。契约师的力量来自它们。

references.work: 浮士德传说与妖精国王传说

image.brief: Four enormous shadowy patron figures loom behind a single unrolled glowing contract held by a small mortal in the foreground: a fae queen crowned with thorns and frost, a horned demon prince in ember-lit robes, a crowned skeletal lich-king, and a vague towering shape of tentacles and stars; each extends one hand toward the contract.
